=========================================================================================================
In short, I bought the entire collection before FANTIA's new censorship rules came into effect, forcing many FANTIA authors to hide some of their works.

Combining these two collections (https://e-hentai.org/g/2484363/4cb74a1ac2/ and https://e-hentai.org/g/2151825/60fff8b262/) basically covers all of this author's paid FANTIA content. I've verified that it only lacks one or two free images and some purely draft content that's not worth uploading.
I also made appropriate adjustments to the order of some images when I uploaded them.

If you have the means, I still recommend supporting the original author.
